curriculum.summary: Ontario curriculum sets expectations for what students learn. Elementary subjects include language, mathematics, science and technology, and social studies. Consult the provincial guidance for grade-specific expectations.
curriculum.kindergarten_summary: TDSB describes Kindergarten as inquiry and intentional play-based learning, planned by teachers and early childhood educators.

registration.english_note: English Kindergarten registration begins in January. The board directs families to their local school for exact dates and times; no school-specific deadline is verified here.
registration.regular_note: For registration or a transfer during the selected school year, contact the school office. No school-specific closing date is verified in this directory.
registration.french_note: Early French Immersion is a separate central application for Junior Kindergarten entry in September 2027. This window does not establish placement at either pilot school.

ratings.summary: EQAO reports assessment results; these are different from an overall school rating. Use the school name and address to find the correct school and review the assessment year and grade.
ratings.fraser_note: The Fraser Institute publishes a third-party rating based on academic indicators derived from provincial tests. It is not a TDSB rating or a measure of every aspect of a school.
ratings.score_note: School-specific numeric rating not verified. No score is displayed.
